text:
36 Appeals to [F84Supreme Court].

(1) In the M13Criminal Appeal Act 1968, in—
(a) section 33(1) (right of appeal to House of Lords), and
(b) section 36 (bail),
after “1987” there shall be inserted “ or section 35 of the Criminal Procedure and
Investigations Act 1996 ”.

(2) The judge may continue a preparatory hearing notwithstanding that leave to appeal has
been granted under Part II of the Criminal Appeal Act 1968, but [F85the preparatory
hearing shall not be concluded ] until after the appeal has been determined or
abandoned.
